The MPC judges that the economic recovery has become more evident and the economy should continue to grow, thus lessening the need for an exceptionally accommodative monetary policy.

With a view to bringing policy interest rate closer to normal levels, the MPC therefore decided to raise the policy interest rate by 0.25 per cent per annum, from 1.25 to 1.50 per cent per annum, effective immediately.
